chapter.heading: Job Reproaches His Pitiless Friends
chapter.v:
Then Job
answered and said:

“I have
heard many such things;Miserable comforters are you all!

Shall words
of wind have an end?Or what provokes you that you answer?

I also
could speak as you do,If your soul were in my soul’s place.I could heap up words against you,And shake my head at you;

But I
would strengthen you with my mouth,And the comfort of my lips would relieve your grief. [Ps. 35:26; 38:16;]

“Though I
speak, my grief is not relieved;And if I remain silent, how am I eased? [Job 16:11]

But now
He has worn me out;You have made desolate all my company.

You have
shriveled me up,And it is a witness against me;My leanness rises up against meAnd bears witness to my face. [Job 3:23; Ps. 88:8; Lam. 3:7,]

He tears
me in His wrath, and hates me;He gnashes at me with His teeth;My adversary sharpens His gaze on me. [Job 12:17, 19; Ps. 89:44]

They gape
at me with their mouth,They strike me reproachfully on the cheek,They gather together against me. [Job 17:14-16]

God has
delivered me to the ungodly,And turned me over to the hands of the wicked. [Job 13:24;]

I was
at ease, but He has shattered me;He also has taken me by my neck, and shaken me to pieces;He has set me up for His target,

His archers
surround me.He pierces my heart and does not pity;He pours out my gall on the ground. [Job 16:20; Ps.]

He breaks
me with wound upon wound;He runs at me like a warrior.

“I have
sewn sackcloth over my skin,And laid my head in the dust.

My face
is flushed from weeping,And on my eyelids is the shadow of death;

Although no
violence is in my hands,And my prayer is pure.

“O earth,
do not cover my blood,And let my cry have no resting place! [2 Kin. 2:23; Job 17:6]

Surely even
now my witness is in heaven,And my evidence is on high. [Ps. 38:11;]

My friends
scorn me;My eyes pour out tears to God.

Oh, that
one might plead for a man with God,As a man pleads for his neighbor!

For when
a few years are finished,I shall go the way of no return. [Job 13:24, 25; 16:11; 19:6; Ps.]
